    Profile

    Margaret is a peddling merchant from Envylia. Since she offers her beloved Elizabeth any of her goods for free, she's set her prices a little higher than average. She's sweet and social, offering wonderful service to make up for that. Her goods are of good quality as well, so she has a lot of fans.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: 159cm
    Weight: 49kg
    Birthday: Jan 7
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Elizabeth
    Hobbies: Looking for guinea pigs for human experiments
    Illust: keypot
    CV: 山田悠希
